verdict.rationale: The evidence only hints at tokenization. The SDK charges cards through an opaque token as the payment source (sourceId "ccof:..."), and Square documents a Web Payments SDK and a feature to "securely save recurring payment methods." Together these suggest card data is replaced by tokens, but no item states that raw card data stays off the developer's servers or that this reduces PCI DSS scope. missing for 10: explicit documentation of client-side card tokenization (e.g. a Web Payments SDK nonce flow), any statement on PCI DSS scope reduction or SAQ eligibility, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
